name: midnight-theatre
description: The Midnight Theatre (The Majestic) — online multiplayer digital board game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "node server/index.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: node test/fullgame.test.js && node test/rules.test.js && node test/rejoin.test.js && node test/client.test.js
